title: Admin module rebuild (Profile-based admin granting + live admin list refresh)

requirements.summary: Make Profile page admin controls reliably grant admin by Principal ID and refresh the displayed admin list without reload, while hiding admin controls from non-admins.
acceptanceCriteria: From the Profile page, when an admin enters a valid Principal ID and clicks Grant, the backend grants admin rights and returns success.
After a successful grant, the admin list shown on the Profile page includes the newly granted admin without requiring a full page reload.
Invalid Principal IDs are rejected by the UI with a clear error message and do not call the backend.
Non-admin users do not see the Admin Controls section.

file_operations.description: Harden authenticated actor initialization so admin/role checks work reliably across redeploys: align with the authorization component expectations by making any access-control initialization step resilient (e.g., avoid hard failure if a non-typed/internal init function is unavailable), and ensure the rest of the app can still call admin-related backend functions. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the admin list query behavior supports immediate UI updates after a successful grant (stable query key, correct enabled gating for admins only, and predictable refetch behavior after invalidation). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Strengthen the grant-admin mutation for reliability: keep Principal parsing, improve error mapping for clear UI feedback, and ensure admin list + current user profile caches are invalidated/refetched so the Profile page updates without reload. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Rebuild/confirm the Profile page Admin Controls flow end-to-end: validate Principal IDs client-side (no backend call on invalid), call the grant mutation, show English success/error messages, and refresh the displayed admin list after success without full reload; keep admin-only conditional rendering so non-admins never see Admin Controls. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
